{"answer":"规则已更新为policy-4e70eee8f086（v2），月数门槛由原6个月降为至少3个月。当前已确定：permitted=true、hours=8、remote=1、applied=true；未知：months（2–8）、days（1–5）。资格条件化为：months≥3 且 days+1≥4（即days≥3）且 days*8≥30（即days≥4）。因此days≥4时无论months取何允许值均符合；days≤2时无论months如何均不符合；days=3时资格取决于months（≥3则符合，=2则不符合）。故match/path/report仍无法唯一确定，需确认days具体值（关键）及months具体值。旧问题q-eligibility-recheck的规则绑定已失效，需按新规则刷新。","tasks":[{"key":"q-eligibility-recheck","question":"请确认每周现场天数具体值（当前仅知范围1至5天，原排班已失效）以及后续可承诺完整月数具体值（当前仅知范围2至8个月）。按新规则：days≥4则必符合；days≤2则必不符合；days=3时取决于months是否≥3。","factKeys":["months","days","permitted","hours","remote","applied"],"targets":["match","path","report"],"refs":["policy-4e70eee8f086","initial-t-9ea2db355ce0","t-9ea2db355ce0-e1","t-9ea2db355ce0-e3"],"branches":[{"assumptions":{"days":4,"months":2},"eligible":true},{"assumptions":{"days":2,"months":8},"eligible":false}]}],"close":[],"readIds":["doc-7834b4eaa2f762"]}
